subject: Procurement follow-up: Vendor setup & PO vs card for Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Procurement follow-up: Vendor setup & PO vs card for Redwood Inference

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary:
- Orion is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing inference workloads (pilot scope: 2 services, ~100k tokens/day).
- Procurement / vendor setup is the blocking item for moving to an invoice/PO flow.

Open items / asks for your team:
1) Which payment path would you prefer for production: PO (net 30/45) or corporate card?
2) Can you confirm who in procurement will complete our vendor packet (I’ve cc’d Marissa, our vendor intake lead)?
3) Do you need a W-9 (US entity) and bank wiring details? We can provide both.
4) Are you interested in procuring via AWS Marketplace or similar (we support marketplace licensing if that helps)?

Attachments I’ll send in the next email: vendor setup packet (fillable) and our W-9 — these usually speed vendor portal setup.

Proposed next step: If PO is preferred, please share the vendor portal link and the contact on your side; if card, we can provision an initial 30-day pilot on card and switch to PO when ready.

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if helpful.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0173
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionfinance.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionfinance.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement follow-up: Vendor setup & PO vs card for Redwood Inference

Thanks, Dylan — great summary. A few quick answers:

- Payment path: Our standard is PO (net 45) for platform vendors. We can do card for an initial POC under $5k, but for production we’ll need a PO.
- Vendor packet: I’ll have Procurement (cc’d) fill out your packet. I’m also happy to share the vendor portal link once I have the vendor name and W-9.
- Docs: Yes, please send your W-9 and bank details.
- Marketplace: We do use AWS Marketplace for a subset of purchases; I’ll check internally if our finance group will accept that for this category.

Can you send the vendor_setup packet and W-9 to procurement@orionfinance.com? Procurement will track the ticket. Tentative timeline: procurement intake starts next Mon (3/2) and typically completes in 7-10 business days if no tax/banking gaps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Alex Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships
Orion Finance
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionfinance.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement follow-up: Vendor setup & PO vs card for Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Alex. I attached the two files here (fillable vendor packet + our W-9). A few notes that typically help procurement complete the intake without back-and-forth:

- Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc. — bank wiring details are on page 3 of the packet (we can also provide a secure bank letter if needed).
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (on the W-9).
- Contracting: Our standard MSA is in DocuSign; if you need redlines we can introduce Marissa and legal.
- Marketplace: We’re listed on AWS Marketplace (SKU: RED-INF-STD). If procurement prefers marketplace, that often shortens payment setup but may require Marketplace PO flow.

DocuSign link for MSA (optional): https://docusign.com/envelope/EA123456789
HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ORION-2026-001

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa will follow up on vendor intake specifics and handle any required tax or banking proofs.
- We’ll provision a short-term demo instance on card if you want to start immediately, then transition to PO when vendor setup completes.

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet_orion-fillable.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

Thanks — I’ll check back early next week for status.

Best,
Dylan
